video_title: LeBron James Signs With 76ers: Draymond Green Reacts & Reveals How Close Warriors Were

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James signs a two-year deal with the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: LeBron James has signed with the Philadelphia 76ers a two-year $8 million deal with a player option
quotes.quote: LeBron James has signed with the Philadelphia 76ers a two-year $8 million deal with a player option, 15% trade kicker. I've seen a lot of 'what was your reaction' and 'were you blindsided.' I wasn't blindsided because I know a few people that know a few people and I knew the stuff was in the works. I didn't know exactly when the announcement would come, I didn't know exactly how the announcement would come.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: The Mavericks' biggest mistake was their decision-making process
quotes.excerpt: One of the biggest mistakes that they've made was the decision, and I think the decision raised $4 million
quotes.quote: One of the biggest mistakes that LeBron, Maverick, and Randy have made was the decision, and I think the decision raised $4 million for the Boys and Girls Club. It could have possibly raised more than $4 million, but I'm just going to say $4 million. They got crushed for the decision, and it made a lot of money for charity. That was their biggest mistake.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's history makes it difficult to return to Cleveland or Miami
quotes.excerpt: If you go back to Cleveland, even if you go back to Cleveland and win a championship, it's not going to be as good as 2016
quotes.quote: If you go back to Cleveland, even if you go back to Cleveland and win a championship, it's not going to be as good as 2016. So you can only really go mess that up. And if you go to Miami and win a championship, it's not going to be as good as 2012, 2013. So those two places kind of got eliminated just because of that. I ultimately don't think LeBron was ever able to get over the history.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Barkley's criticism of LeBron James chasing rings
quotes.excerpt: I even saw Charles Barkley say, 'Oh, look at it, now he ring chasing. Philly ain't won a ring in 60 years.'
quotes.quote: I even saw Charles Barkley say, 'Oh, look at it, now he ring chasing. Philly ain't won a ring in 60 years.' If he was chasing a ring like chasing a ring, I don't know that you go to the place that's never won in 55 years or 60 years. You got to go do the work to bring that to that place.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Curry might be tired of star chasing
quotes.excerpt: Stephen is probably tired of star chasing
quotes.quote: I saw Marcus Thompson come out and say, 'Steph is probably tired of star chasing.' What I want to point out is, probably. So often times people are negative and don't read and don't comprehend. I saw a lot of people like, 'Uh-oh, Steph said he tired of star chasing.' And when I read this, I was like, 'Huh, Steph is probably tired of star chasing.' That's interesting. Probably would mean maybe he is, maybe he isn't. But probably you definitely can't just cross the probably out and be like, 'Tired of star chasing.' That doesn't work.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Dunleavy and Joe Lacob face criticism for risk aversion
quotes.excerpt: I've also seen that Mike Dunleavy and Joe Lacob have gotten a lot of criticism for their lack of risk taking
quotes.quote: I've also seen that Mike Dunleavy and Joe Lacob have gotten a lot of criticism for their lack of risk taking over the last few years, playing it for the post-Steph era. And listen, there's always going to be backlash when you're not winning. It happens to everyone. That's just what comes with the territory. But I don't think going to trade for Jimmy Butler would be considered lack of taking risks, especially signing him to a two-year $121 million extension. I don't think that would be considered a lack of taking risk. I also don't believe that trading for Dennis Schroder, trying to make something happen, is a lack of taking risk.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Bob Myers and the 76ers' roster construction
quotes.excerpt: You got to give Bob a lot of credit in identifying the guy who to go get
quotes.quote: You got to give Mike Dunleavy some credit. He's in the saddle every day building this roster. But you got to give Bob a lot of credit in identifying the guy who to go get. And then Bob is kind of on his Jerry West right now. Bob coming in, big dog, haymakers at the end, going on Rich Paul podcast, politicking and shit. Bob doing his big one, man. Bob said, 'Listen, I'm running all these franchises, and I'm going to come in when I need to come in.' And he come in, he closed the deal. So yeah, Bob does it again.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James will have to play point guard for the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: LeBron James is probably going to be the point guard
quotes.quote: LeBron James is probably going to be the point guard. I know everybody's like, 'Oh man, he going to play the four.' He going to have to play the point to get everybody involved. I think it's asking a lot of Tyrese Maxey to say, 'Yo, Maxey, you playing the point, you need to figure out to get VJ Edgecombe involved, you need to figure out how to get Bron involved, you need to figure out how to get Jaylen Brown involved.' Oh, by the way, Tyrese Maxey, you also need to figure out how to get Joel Embiid involved. I don't feel like that's setting up Tyrese Maxey or the Philadelphia 76ers for success by doing that. So Bron's going to have to be the point guard number one.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James needs to figure out touches for the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: Bron is then going to be on him to figure out touches
quotes.quote: Bron is then going to be on him to figure out touches. Because the touches in this situation ain't great. Jaylen Brown need touches, Maxey need touches, Embiid need touches, VJ Edgecombe need touches, and VJ Edgecombe need touches and Bron obviously is going to get touches. So it's not the perfect mix, no, when you're talking to starting five. It is arguably the most talent, but like from a fit perspective, there could be rosters in the NBA and starting fives that fit a little better.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Defensive responsibilities for Jaylen Brown and VJ Edgecombe
quotes.excerpt: It's going to be more responsibility on Jaylen Brown to guard
quotes.quote: It's going to be more responsibility on Jaylen Brown to guard. VJ Edgecombe, you now got to guard the number one best guard, like every night. That's your responsibility. So, you know, that's going to require some sacrifice. That's going to require some buy-in from a young fella. Young fella had a great rookie year, he coming back into his second year thinking like, 'Yo, this my chance to take that jump.' He kind of the fifth option.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: VJ Edgecombe is the biggest loser in the 76ers' roster moves
quotes.excerpt: If I'm VJ Edgecombe's agent, I'm not sure I'm happy with the summer that the 76ers have had
quotes.quote: If I'm VJ Edgecombe's agent, I'm not sure I'm happy with the summer that the 76ers have had. If I'm VJ Edgecombe's agent, I'm not sure I'm happy with the summer that the 76ers have had because this could affect a lot for VJ Edgecombe. Like you go from being sometimes the second option when Embiid was out to sometimes being the fifth option. It's a big, big, big difference. I don't know if y'all understand like how big of a difference that is.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: The Eastern Conference landscape has shifted with recent moves
quotes.excerpt: It definitely shifts the East a bit
quotes.quote: It definitely shifts the East a bit. Obviously, I think Boston's taking a step back. You look at the Knicks, you look at obviously Philly, Detroit. How is Detroit coming back next year? They've lost a couple pieces, brought a couple pieces in, right? But you know, you're losing Tobias, I think that's going to be big for them. They're going to have to depend on John Collins a lot. And this is a big jump for John, you know, he was starting for years and then kind of went to the bench in in Utah, sometimes started and came off the bench some last year for the Clippers. He back like being depended on in a major way.
